reason: The text is a narrative account of Moses' birth and early childhood (Exodus 2:1-10). While it mentions the house of Levi as the ethnic/familial origin of the characters, the passage makes no statements, comparisons, or assertions regarding the authority, leadership capabilities, or superiority of priests versus non-priests. The text focuses on events (hiding the child, discovering the basket, adoption by Pharaoh's daughter) rather than on any hierarchical claims about leadership structures or priestly status.
